subject: Reminder: Unpaid Parking Violation - $violation_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is a reminder that you have an unpaid parking violation.

Violation ID: $violation_id
Violation Type: $violation_type
Vehicle: $license_plate
Original Fine: £$fine_amount
Days Overdue: $days_overdue

Please pay this violation immediately to avoid:
- Late fees (£10 added after 30 days)
- Academic hold on your account
- Registration suspension
- Vehicle impoundment

Pay online at: https://university.edu/parking/violations
Or visit the Parking Services Office at Student Services Building, Room 120.

Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Email: parking@university.edu

If you have already paid this fine, please disregard this message.

$signature
